plan.author_host_rule: Issuer-authored NSE/BSE attachment remains ISSUER_PRIMARY; exchange-authored circular is EXCHANGE_PRIMARY. Hosting alone never upgrades authorship.
closure_rules: Preserve every one of 844 parent pending IDs and all 80 original cells; no merging/dropping cells.
A resolved document is not complete negative category coverage. Count unresolved older pending coverage separately.
Unknown or inaccessible original, conflict, date or security mechanics stays unresolved.
Do not promote any cell merely from exhausted queue or stable reference identity.
Named LT Realty, SuFin and Metro questions require issuer-specific mechanics; no assumed EQ segmentation.
Use original text/visual evidence; snippets and index labels are navigation only.
Preserve four dividend boundaries unless original authoritative correction proves otherwise.
plan.completeness_standard: Every category requires explicit authoritative scope and complete effective-date coverage. Empty query, snippet, current reference or single dividend announcement cannot prove absence. All general-update attachments relevant to action mechanics and earlier-announced pending events require review. Dated EQ masters prove symbol/series/ISIN and par-value observations only, not economic-action completeness. Finite lookback alone cannot exclude older pending schemes. Record exact residual gap instead of certifying by silence.
